translation: In the depression below the large bone behind the root segment (benjie) of the small toe on the outer side of the foot, at the border of the red and white [skin]; needle three fen, moxa seven cones (zhuang). The popliteal fossa (weizhong) is the Weizhong point (BL40), [which is] in the transverse line behind the bent knee; needle three fen.
